properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Standard React Native debug keystore (JKS) committed at android/app/debug.keystore. Critical context found in android/app/build.gradle:150-153: storePassword/keyPassword are hardcoded to 'android' (public template values), and the RELEASE buildType (line 168) reuses signingConfigs.debug — so release APKs are signed with the public, forgeable debug key. Changeable here: generate a real release keystore. The JKS store is key material at rest, identified by content as a keystore.
